rows.title: Important flagship programmes of the Central Government - agriculture, rural, urban, employment, skilling

secs.t: Agriculture schemes → objective and funding partner

x: Under PMFBY, the farmer premium is
2% for kharif crops, 1.5% for rabi crops and 5% for commercial and horticultural crops
The Small Farmers’ Agribusiness Consortium (
SFAC
) is the lead agency for e-NAM, which links Agricultural Produce Market Committees through an online national agricultural market.
PMKSY is associated with the objectives or slogans ‘Har Khet ko Pani’ and ‘More crop per drop’.

secs.t: Scheme lineage and chronology

x: Exam angle: the APPSC 2025 key gives SGSY as
. The scheme actually started on
1 April 1999
(some keys say 1995). Learn 1999 and recognise the key's option.
NRLM was restructured from SGSY in 2011 and was renamed Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana–National Rural Livelihoods Mission in 2016.
The six Bharat Nirman components were irrigation, roads, housing, drinking water, electrification and telephony.

secs.t: Rural development - SAGY, MPLADS, DAY-NRLM, PMGSY, Hariyali, SPMRM, SVAMITVA

x: All four statements correctly describe MPLADS: MoSPI administers it, funds are non-lapsable, MPs recommend works, district authorities execute them, and the specified SC/ST earmarks apply.
The current funding pattern stated for DAY-NRLM is 60:40 generally, 90:10 for the North-Eastern States including Sikkim, and 100 per cent Central funding for Union Territories.
SPMRM seeks to create Rurban clusters with the phrase ‘rural soul, urban amenities’.
SPMRM was launched in 2016, covers more than 300 Rurban clusters and works through convergence without a separate funding silo.

secs.t: Employment - MGNREGA features, now VB-G RAM G

x: MGNREGA guaranteed 100 days of unskilled manual work per household per year, whereas VB-G RAM G provides a 125-day guarantee.
VB-G RAM G replaces MGNREGA, raises the guarantee to 125 days and is implemented through Panchayati Raj Institutions.
VB-G RAM G follows a 60:40 pattern generally and 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States; Union Territories without legislatures receive 100 per cent Central funding.

secs.t: Central programme objectives → scheme

x: PM Vishwakarma is under MSME, PM-AJAY under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, PM SVANidhi under MoHUA, and KVIC is the nodal agency for PMEGP.
PM SVANidhi supports street vendors through working-capital loans; the first loan is ₹10,000 and the scheme provides a 7 per cent interest subsidy and digital cashback.

secs.t: Urban programmes → objective

x: The 2026–27 budget allocation for SBM-Urban 2.0 was stated to have been halved to
₹2,500 crore
The Urban Challenge Fund is a ₹1 lakh crore Centrally Sponsored Scheme under MoHUA for FY 2025–26 to 2030–31.
MoHUA was formed in 2017 by merging the Ministry of Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation with the Ministry of Urban Development.

secs.t: Skilling - PMKVY, Skill India, SIDH, NAPS, SANKALP

x: NAPS supported stipends for 54.41 lakh apprentices, Jan Shikshan Sansthan trained 36.52 lakh people, and the PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana paid ₹2,400 crore to 15 lakh first-time employees.
SANKALP is a World Bank-supported programme of MSDE intended to strengthen district-level skilling institutions.
APSSDC is setting up 50 skill hubs in rural colleges in association with technology firms.

secs.t: Scheme → nodal ministry and funding pattern

x: DAY-NRLM, VB-G RAM G, PMAY-G and PM-AJAY
are listed as Centrally Sponsored Schemes.
The general pattern is 60:40, changing to 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States and 100 per cent Central funding for Union Territories without legislatures.
The Urban Challenge Fund is listed as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, not a Central Sector scheme with universal 100 per cent Central funding.

secs.t: Universal angles

x: The Andhra Pradesh Budget for 2026–27 allotted ₹8,365 crore to VB-G RAM G.
A major debate concerns whether funding should follow a normative allocation formula or remain demand-driven.
The CAG audit found that the planned convergence was not achieved.
APSSDC skill hubs are associated with skilling in Andhra Pradesh, not with the normative allocation formula for rural employment.

secs.t: Energy programmes → objective and ministry

x: Component A covers decentralised plants on barren or fallow land; Component B covers standalone off-grid pumps; and Component C covers solarisation of existing grid-connected pumps.
The National Quantum Mission is associated with DST, IndiaAI with MeitY, the National Green Hydrogen Mission with MNRE, and the RDI Scheme with DST through ANRF.

secs.t: MUDRA and enterprise credit

x: MUDRA means
Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency
MUDRA is under the Ministry of Finance, was launched in April 2015, aims to fund the unfunded, and prioritises SC/ST enterprises.
The three slabs are Shishu up to ₹50,000, Kishor from ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh, and Tarun from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh.

secs.t: Region- and sector-specific missions

x: PM-DevINE was announced in Union Budget 2022-23 to
close development gaps in the North Eastern Region
PM-DevINE is under the Ministry of DoNER, is fully centrally funded, and was announced in Union Budget 2022-23.
ZED stands for Zero Defect Zero Effect and certifies MSMEs for quality and low environmental impact.

secs.t: Scheme launch-year matching

x: Make in India was launched in 2014, Digital India in 2015, Startup India in 2016 and Atmanirbhar Bharat in 2020.
Atmanirbhar Bharat was launched in May 2020, not May 2019.
PAHAL was launched in November 2014 and rolled out nationwide in January 2015.
Startup India
was launched on 16 January 2016.

secs.t: Infrastructure programmes → objective

x: PM Gati Shakti, launched in October 2021, is a GIS-based National Master Plan for integrated multimodal connectivity planning across ministries.
The Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor runs from Ludhiana towards Sonnagar/Dankuni, while the Western corridor runs from Dadri to JNPT.
The stated figures are 657 running UDAN routes, expansion to 120 new destinations, and Indian logistics costs of about 13–14 percent of GDP.

secs.t: Digital programmes - Aadhaar, Digital India, BharatNet, ISM, IndiaAI, ONDC, PM-WANI

x: ONDC is an open network for digital commerce promoted by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (
DPIIT
BharatNet, 5G, UPI, Aadhaar, DigiYatra and FASTag form the identified DPI backbone.
The nine pillars include broadband highways, universal mobile access, public internet access, e-Governance, e-Kranti, information for all, electronics manufacturing, IT for jobs and early harvest.

secs.t: Industry programmes → objective

x: PLI is
a Central Sector scheme covering 14 sectors
, including electronics, pharmaceuticals, telecom and auto components.
Startup India includes
a ₹10,000 crore Fund of Funds managed by SIDBI
Startup India provides a three-year tax holiday, permits self-certification under nine labour and environment laws, and provides for winding up in 90 days.

secs.t: Scheme → implementing ministry and nodal agency

x: SIDBI is associated with MUDRA refinance and the Fund of Funds for Startups; IREDA is the renewable-energy financing arm; and NHAI is associated with Bharatmala highways.
IREDA is the renewable-energy financing arm of the
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
(MNRE).
EESL/REC are associated with UJALA, DDUGJY and Saubhagya, while KVIC is associated with PMEGP and Solar Charkha.

secs.t: Universal angles

x: The
PM Surya Ghar drive
in Andhra Pradesh is identified as a current-relevance issue.
High logistics costs, low R&D spending and the continuing need for support to DISCOM finances are all identified challenges.
The Andhra Pradesh angle includes three industrial corridors, VCIC’s association with the Asian Development Bank, and a top-four rank in rooftop solar.

sub: Group-II S3-45: Welfare programmes of the Government of Andhra Pradesh - social security and welfare schemes

secs.t: AP welfare flagships - beneficiary, benefit, eligibility (Super Six, Navaratnalu, Talliki Vandanam, Cheyutha, Aasara, Vahana Mitra)

x: Exam angle: scheme → benefit matching, and old name → new name.
The Chief Minister reviewed the delivery of the
Super Six
guarantee package at the 8th Collectors’ Conference on 12 September 2026.
Talliki Vandanam is intended to reduce the cost of schooling and raise the
Gross Enrolment Ratio
Navaratnalu comprised all nine listed pillars: Rythu Bharosa, fee reimbursement, Aarogyasri, Jalayagnam, prohibition, Amma Vodi, pensions, Pedalandariki Illu and YSR Aasara/Cheyutha.
YSR Aasara repaid the outstanding bank loans of women’s Self-Help Groups as on 11 April 2019 in
four instalments
All three statements are correct: Stree Shakti was launched on 15 August 2025, later extended to persons with disabilities, and women’s share of bus travel rose from 40% to 65%.
The earlier
Deepam, launched in 1999
, provided LPG connections, whereas Deepam-2 provides three free LPG cylinders a year.
Annadata Sukhibhava with PM-KISAN provides
per farmer family annually, comprising ₹14,000 from the State and ₹6,000 under PM-KISAN.
Annadata Sukhibhava includes tenant farmers, and the Budget 2026–27 provision mentioned for it is ₹6,600 crore.
The jobs guarantee aims at
20 lakh jobs in five years
through ITI and skill placements.
Navaratnalu was the YSRCP's programme of
nine welfare promises
announced in 2019.

secs.t: Social security pensions - NTR Bharosa (earlier YSR Pension Kanuka): categories, age, amounts

x: Exam angle: the ₹3,000 → ₹4,000 revision and the 60/18 age limits.
Arya Vysya, Brahmin, Kapu, EBC, Kamma, Reddy and Kshatriya communities received the same ₹3,000 to ₹4,000 enhancement.
The Budget Estimate for NTR Bharosa in 2024–25 was
₹4,407 crore
. ₹2,693 crore refers to a later monthly release, while ₹19,305 crore is the 2026–27 health budget.
Pension distribution is automated using
Aadhaar-based biometric authentication
, intended to eliminate ghost beneficiaries.
The 16th Finance Commission found Andhra Pradesh to have the highest
per-capita social security pension spending
among States.
All three statements are correct: there were 63.12 lakh pensions, monthly expenditure was ₹2,744 crore, and payments used biometric Aadhaar-based authentication.
NTR Bharosa Pension provides monthly assistance to
elderly persons, widows, single women, weavers, fishermen and artisans
, among others.
Andhra Pradesh renamed the scheme as NTR Bharosa Pension, uses Aadhaar-based biometric verification and adds State funds to central NSAP assistance.
NTR Bharosa Pension provides monthly pensions ranging from
to eligible beneficiaries.
From January 2026,
real-time Aadhaar biometric verification
was introduced to automate distribution and remove ghost beneficiaries.

secs.t: Health welfare - Dr NTR Vaidya Seva/Aarogyasri, 104/108, Family Physician

x: The model announced in May 2025 proposed annual coverage up to ₹25 lakh for about 1.65 crore poor and middle-class families and was announced by Y. Satya Kumar Yadav.
The 104 service operates mobile medical units providing fixed-day village health services, whereas 108 provides emergency ambulance services.
The 108 emergency service had 768 ambulances and transported 9.22 lakh patients during 2024–25.
EHS provides cashless treatment for State government employees and pensioners through the Dr NTR Vaidya Seva Trust.
The Dr YSR Aarogyasri scheme, introduced in 2007, is now known as
Dr NTR Vaidya Seva

secs.t: Women's safety and support - Disha, One Stop Centres, women development

x: The Disha Bill, 2019 proposed completion of
investigation within 7 days and trial within 14 days
, making the total period 21 days.
The Disha Bill proposed amendments to
the Indian Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure
for dealing with sexual offences against women.
One Stop Centre
s provide police, medical, legal, counselling and shelter support to women facing violence under one roof.

secs.t: Maternal and child schemes - purpose

x: Talli Bidda Express
provides free transport for the mother and newborn from the government hospital to their home after delivery.
Giri Gorumudda provides nutrition support to
tribal mothers and young children in Agency areas
YSR Sampoorna Poshana provides supplementary nutrition to
pregnant and lactating women and children aged 6–72 months
through Anganwadis.

secs.t: Minority and caste welfare - beneficiary

x: Dulhan or YSR Shaadi Tohfa provides marriage assistance for brides belonging to poor minority, particularly Muslim, families.
Jagananna Chedodu provides ₹10,000 per year to
self-employed tailors, rajakas and nayee brahmins
with shops.
The Budget Estimate for Welfare of SC, ST, OBC and Minorities was
₹47,277 crore
in 2024–25, representing the largest sector and a 31% increase over the Revised Estimate.

secs.t: Civic and sanitation campaigns - CLAP, Swachha Andhra

x: CLAP focuses on door-to-door collection of segregated garbage and sanitation activities across Andhra Pradesh.
All three statements are correct as stated: 96.07% waste segregation, 6,890 tonnes per day processed, and 104 STPs with 171 under construction.
CLAP recorded 96.07% waste segregation at source, processing of 6,890 tonnes daily and 104 functioning STPs.

secs.t: Governance for welfare delivery - Secretariats, volunteers, DBT, PGRS/Spandana

x: e-Seva was introduced in 2001, followed by MeeSeva as a single-window service, and Village/Ward Secretariats were introduced in 2019.
Direct Benefit Transfer through the JAM trinity helps
reduce ghost beneficiaries and middlemen
in welfare delivery.
e-Seva dates to 2001, P4 was launched on 30 March 2025, the GSWS amendment belongs to 2026, and the 62 rural Anna Canteens opened on 15 April 2026.

secs.t: Food, housing and education welfare - ration, Anna Canteens, Pedalandariki Illu, Vidya/Vasathi Deevena

x: Door delivery of ration through mobile dispensing units began in 2021.
Anna Canteens provide subsidised meals primarily for the urban poor.
Pedalandariki Illu provides house sites and houses for poor women.
The stated Housing for All target was 7.60 lakh houses by 2026, using convergence between PMAY-U and PMAY-G and tracking through CFMS.

secs.t: Navaratnalu and sector schemes - sector

x: Navaratnalu comprised nine flagship welfare promises for 2019–24 and was funded from revenue expenditure along with rice and power subsidies and pensions.
The stated changes are Auto Driver Sevalo at ₹15,000, Matsyakara Bharosa at ₹20,000 per family, and replacement of Rythu Bharosa by Annadata Sukhibhava at ₹20,000.
YSR Vahana Mitra provided ₹10,000 annually to self-owned auto or taxi drivers, while the current Auto Driver Sevalo provides ₹15,000 annually to owners of self-owned autos.

secs.t: AP housing - housing for the poor, Jagananna/NTR housing, house site pattas, AP State Housing Corporation

x: The AP State Housing Corporation, also referred to as APHCL, runs the Weaker Section Housing Programme with the motto “Housing for All”.
The policy provides house sites of
3 cents in rural areas and 2 cents in urban areas
for every eligible homeless household by 2029.
The stated target concerns 7.60 lakh houses in progress, to be completed by March 2026 under PMAY-U (BLC), PMAY-G and PM-JANMAN.

secs.t: AP women development and child welfare - Sampoorna Poshana, anganwadi reforms, SHG schemes (Aasara, Cheyutha)

x: Sampoorna Poshana/Poshana Plus provides
richer take-home rations through Anganwadi Centres
The reform programme covers 55,746 Anganwadi Centres in 257 projects and includes Saksham Anganwadi upgrades and fortified take-home rations.
SERP covers 84.47 lakh rural women and has first-in-India SHG-bank linkage with 99.99% recovery.
APSES 2024–25 recorded ₹633.74 crore transferred through DBT to 69,597 SHG members under YSR Aasara.

secs.t: AP community-specific welfare - marriage assistance, Kapu, BC, SC and ST schemes

x: Chandranna Pelli Kanuka covered SC, ST, BC, minorities and disabled persons; YSR Kalyanamasthu covered the same broad groups; Shaadi Tohfa was for Muslims; Dulhan was for Muslim brides and began in April 2015.

All four statements are correct: the monthly assistance is ₹5,000–10,000, the annual expenditure is ₹180 crore, Urdu is the second official language, and Haj and Jerusalem pilgrimage assistance is provided.

secs.t: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens

x: The GSWS (Amendment) Bill, 2026 revises the roles of functionaries in the context of Swarna Andhra 2047.
The ₹3–5 below-market pricing and Digital Rupee linkage relate to Mee Mart, not Anna Canteens.
The 62 rural Anna Canteens were opened at
Dharanikota in Palnadu
on 15 April 2026.
The addition of 62 rural canteens took the total number of Anna Canteens to 269.

secs.t: Universal angles

x: The family was treated as the unit for delivery of the Super Six benefits, with family mapping preceding the introduction of new pensions.
Kerala’s pension amount is ₹2,000 per month and its delivery is shifting towards DBT; Andhra Pradesh is identified as having the highest per-head social-pension spending among States.

rows.title: Important policies and programmes of the Government of Andhra Pradesh - agriculture, industry, IT and infrastructure

secs.t: AP agriculture programmes - purpose and benefit (Rythu Bharosa, zero-interest loans, Jala Kala, tenants, RBKs, APCNF, e-Crop, PMFBY)

x: YSR Rythu Bharosa–PM KISAN provides
per year to each farmer family, of which ₹6,000 is provided under PM-KISAN.
PMFBY coverage in Andhra Pradesh rose with extreme-weather losses, and the specified farmer premium rates apply; the scheme has been voluntary for all farmers since Kharif 2020.
YSR Jala Kala provides free borewells; YSR Rythu Bharosa provides investment support; Rythu Bazars facilitate farmer-to-consumer sales; and Jala Yagnam concerns irrigation projects.

secs.t: AP industrial and startup policies - period, issuing department, goals

x: Exam angle: acronym expansion (LIFT), issuing department, and which policy carries which slogan.

The Industrial Development Policy targets large investment and higher project categories; the MSME policy carries the One Family, One Entrepreneur approach; the Food Processing Policy promotes value addition and cold chains; and the Electronics Manufacturing Policy has the stated production, investment and employment targets.

secs.t: AP e-governance and land records - MeeSeva, BhuSeva, FiberNet, RTG, data centres

x: BhuSeva assigns a unique
Bhudhaar number
to each land parcel as part of its integrated land-records system.
AP FiberNet is a fibre grid launched in 2017 to provide
low-cost broadband, television and telephone
services to homes and offices.
Real Time Governance
operates through a command centre at the Secretariat for real-time monitoring of services and grievances.

secs.t: Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 - principles and flagship goals

x: Swarna Andhra@2047 provides the framework for
the 2024–29 policies and industrial corridors
in Andhra Pradesh.
The PanIIT Summit 2026 is scheduled at Vijayawada on 3 October 2026 to shape a DeepTech roadmap for Swarna Andhra@2047.
The five panels are energy and fuel-cost optimisation; DeepTech; space and defence manufacturing; BioValley; and agri-tech, water and blue economy.

secs.t: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

x: APIIC may now directly allot up to 50 acres without Cabinet approval; NIMZs have been proposed in Chittoor and Prakasam.
SIPB approved 8 projects in FY 2024–25 involving ₹2,45,275 crore and 65,541 jobs.
APIIC may directly allot up to
50 acres
without Cabinet approval under the stated June 2026 change.

secs.t: Amaravati capital - CRDA, phase-wise works

x: APCRDA was established under the
APCRDA Act, 2014
The Budget Estimate for Amaravati in 2024–25 was
₹3,000 crore

secs.t: AP infrastructure projects - location/purpose (Polavaram, Bhogapuram, ports, Anakapalli, Kopparthy)

x: All four statements are correct regarding Polavaram’s legal status, progress, target year and 2024–25 budget provision.
The reduction in Machilipatnam port limits from 64 km to 15 km was made under the
Indian Ports Act, 2025
Kopparthy is associated with
an electronics manufacturing cluster and an NICP node
in YSR Kadapa district.

secs.t: AP energy, green and aqua policies - Clean Energy Policy, pumped storage, green hydrogen, Aqua Authority, fishing harbours

x: The policy covers solar, wind, hybrid energy, pumped storage, green hydrogen and ammonia, biofuels, storage and EV charging.
Andhra Pradesh has more than 638 IGBC projects covering 627.58 million square feet.
The Aqua Authority regulates aqua farms, aquaculture seed and aquaculture feed under the AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020.

secs.t: Universal angles

x: The Cabinet cleared the drafts of the PPP Policy-2026 and Omnibus EoDB Act 2026.
The industrial initiatives signify Rayalaseema’s transformation from a drought-prone region into an industrial hub.
Andhra Pradesh recorded 2,61,393 MSMEs set up in 2024–25 and ranked sixth in exports.
